name: Fabric-Grille Cylindrical Speaker
description: A compact cylindrical wireless speaker with a brushed warm-silver aluminum shell, a soft woven charcoal fabric grille band around its middle, and a single matte amber-lit control button on the flat top.
materials: brushed warm-silver aluminum shell, soft woven charcoal fabric grille band, matte amber-lit top button, rubberized base ring
primaryColors: warm silver, charcoal grey, amber accent
negativeConstraints: never render any text, logo, wordmark, engraving, or printing anywhere on the speaker body, rim, button, or base; never render a second button, a visible cable, or any label; never let the fabric grille read as printed texture rather than genuine woven fabric
preservationNotes: the brushed-aluminum finish, single amber top button, charcoal fabric grille band, rubberized base ring, and completely plain unmarked surfaces must read identically in every angle, same proportions throughout
